prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional Air Traffic Flow Management and Airport Collaborative Decision-Making System:Regional Flow Platform=Cedarbell;Meridian International Airport/Harbor East Airport/North Valley Airport/Lakeside Regional Airport/Southport Airport retain authority. Aliases:Airline Operations Coordinator=Saffron;Regional Flow Manager=Copperfin;Demand Prediction Service=Marlinstone;Weather Ingest Gateway=Orchard;Airport CDM Portal=Foxglove;Tower Supervisor=Brindle(advisory-only);Ramp Control Lead=Quartzline;Slot Allocation Engine=Blueharbor;Slot Coordinator=Halcyon;Tower Sequence Manager=Ironleaf;Ramp Movement Board=Skylark;Alert Distribution Hub=Lantern;Departure Metering Service=Emberline;Arrival Regulation Console=Nightjar(help-only). Airline Operations Centre→Airline Interface Adapter→Flight Data Exchange:Flight Intent Message;Identity Access Service authenticates;invalid/incomplete rejected(reason-codes);material intents supersede schedules;changes require messages. Cedarbell normalizes Airport Capacity Plan;Capacity Assessment Module updates Airport Acceptance Rate/runway/taxiway/sector/apron constraints. Blueharbor→Adapter/Foxglove:Calculated Takeoff Time/Target Off Block Time/arrival-opportunities;freeze:Pushback Window Token. Capacity>preferences;safety/emergency/humanitarian/national-obligation>commercial>discretionary;Ground Delay Program equity;Halcyon confirms publication/compliance;changes justified;stands cannot override airspace. Orchard validates weather/provenance/overrides;Storm Cell Snapshot confidence/degradation/provisional-capacity visible;Meteorology Briefing Officer verifies. East Apron Sensor/West Apron Sensor→Skylark→Surface Surveillance Adapter→Foxglove:movements/milestones≤5s;validated occupancy/equipment-status→Skylark/Ironleaf. Quartzline→Blueharbor:Stand Tow Request Form;Brindle/Airport Duty Manager resolve conflicts;Runway Inspection Note precedes endorsement;North Runway Meter/South Runway Meter receive capacities. Normal Operations/Adverse Weather Mode/Capacity Reduction State/Recovery Phase:coordinated recovery,commercial-logic protection;Contingency Fallback State:diversion/prioritization/communication/recovery. Saffron confirms plans/deferrals/revised-intents;Brindle distinguishes surface/runway/downstream holds;Handling Resource Planner grades severity/suppresses recovery-duplicates;Ground Handling Dispatcher→Towbar;Aircraft Operator Representative supplies crew-legality.

New part:
S671: The Slot Coordinator reviews any exception raised by the Slot Allocation Engine and confirms whether the swap remains consistent with regional flow objectives.
S672: Slot Coordinator sends the Slot Swap Permission Email only after the governance checks have been completed and recorded.
S673: For airline-to-airline coordination, each Aircraft Operator Representative records concurrence in the Airport CDM Portal rather than relying on a verbal agreement.
S674: The Network Operations Liaison monitors aggregate displacement from approved substitutions to ensure that one carrier's recovery action does not destabilize the wider network plan.
S675: The Regional Flow Manager may suspend collaborative substitution during a Capacity Reduction State when scarce capacity must be protected for the published tactical plan.
S676: The Tower Supervisor retains authority to reject a swap if the resulting sequence would conflict with safe runway sequencing or local control workload.
S677: The Ramp Control Lead confirms that the revised sequence remains compatible with stand occupancy, pushback spacing, and tug availability shown on the Ramp Movement Board.
S678: Airport Duty Manager uses the Apron Sweep Completion Note to confirm that apron availability constraints do not invalidate an approved substitution.
S679: Airline Operations Coordinator uses the release note to confirm that a candidate substitution is eligible for customs release before requesting a slot swap.
S680: Customs release status is treated as a prerequisite condition for any substitution that would move an international departure into an earlier operating position.
S681: If customs status is incomplete, the Airport CDM Portal keeps the proposal pending and prevents the Slot Allocation Engine from publishing the revised slot assignment.
S682: The Collaborative Decision Log captures the proposed flights, the reason code, the user confirmations, the governance outcome, and the final decision time.
S683: The Audit Event Ledger records each approval, rejection, cancellation, and override so that later review can distinguish operational judgment from system enforcement.
S684: The Flight Data Exchange publishes revised Flight Intent Message content only after the approved substitution is final and time synchronized.
S685: The Common Situation Display presents the updated Calculated Takeoff Time and Target Off Block Time so that operational users share the same view of the accepted change.
S686: The Departure Metering Service recalculates metering advisories after approval and prevents the swap from creating a new demand peak at a departure fix.
S687: Disputes between operators are escalated to the Regional Flow Manager when the recorded concurrences conflict or when a party alleges that governance rules were bypassed.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
